Quick task, first impressions please.
Each item below shows three symbols.
For each item, answer with one of:
  - "none": true, if they don't seem to go in any sequence
  - "two": just two of them, if only those two seem to go together
  - "seq": all three, written in the sequence they seem to form (either end first)
Copy each symbol exactly, or write "#1", "#2", … for its place in the item.
Go by first impressions, and judge each item on its own rather than building a scheme across items.
"none" is expected often and is fully valuable.
Symbols that seem to be the same step go together in a nested list, like ["<s1>", ["<s2>", "<s3>"]].

Reply with JSON only, no prose: {"answers": [ ... ]}, one entry per item, each one of: {"id": <id>, "seq": [...]} or {"id": <id>, "two": [...]} or {"id": <id>, "none": true}.
